description: Hand-labeled support tickets for triage evaluation. Evaluated as of `now` so book-record facts (overdue royalties) are reproducible.

labelingGuide.category: The one category a BookLeaf agent would file the ticket under. alsoAcceptable lists a second category that is defensible for genuinely overlapping tickets; lenient accuracy counts it.
labelingGuide.Critical: Money owed seriously overdue: six months or more stated by the author, or a book record with >= ₹1,000 pending and no payout for more than two payout cycles; legal threats or fraud.
labelingGuide.High: ISBN errors (duplicate, wrong book linked, mismatch); royalties overdue (three months or more stated, or proven by the book record); a published book unavailable for sale; defects across a large order.
labelingGuide.Medium: Print defects on individual copies; production delays; questions about royalty amounts or deductions; missing payments with no stated or recorded delay; account access problems; listing data errors.
labelingGuide.Low: Information requests and routine changes where nothing is lost.
labelingGuide.book: bookCode from the sample dataset whose record triage may use as evidence; null for account-level tickets.
